findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list-open-anomaly-cases, list-comment-status, start-month-run, draft-report-comment · Private data: upload-budget-entries, answer-clarification · Public sink: compute_aggregates, search_cost_center_transactions, get_metric_trend, create-budget-plan, upload-budget-entries, propose-manual-adjustment, propose-transaction-correction, get-variance-bridge · Destructive: get-month-run-status, list-open-anomaly-cases, list-comment-status, start-month-run, note-anomaly-case, generate-month-report, draft-report-comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list-open-anomaly-cases, list-comment-status, start-month-run, draft-report-comment · Private data: upload-budget-entries, answer-clarification · Public sink: compute_aggregates, search_cost_center_transactions, get_metric_trend, create-budget-plan, upload-budget-entries, propose-manual-adjustment, propose-transaction-correction, get-variance-bridge · Destructive: get-month-run-status, list-open-anomaly-cases, list-comment-status, start-month-run, note-anomaly-case, generate-month-report, draft-report-comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
